title: What Shape is the Inflationary Bispectrum?
summary: Non-linear interactions during inflation generate non-Gaussianities in the distribution of primordial curvature. In many theories, the physics is scale-invariant, such that the induced three-point function depends solely on a dimensionless shape function $S(x,y)\sim k^6B_ζ(kx,ky,k)$. To confront such models with observations, one typically builds specialized estimators for each shape, then applies them to cosmic microwave background datasets at significant computational expense.
